svg.title: Resonance After Colour Erasure
svg.desc: The violet and magenta family is removed from twenty-one incommensurate resonances using its original stroke-color range. Surviving trajectories are mapped into two temporary color classes; every third becomes a coarse polygon and then a comb of normal vectors. A final grayscale remap and slight shear retain both untouched oscillations and their geometric descendants.
